--> Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources So This Happened : TUC rejects FG’s ₦70,000 monthly transport support, demands ₦300,000 minimum wage So This Happened October 29, 2026 8:33 pm By Our Reporters Kindly share this story:
The Federal Government has approved ₦70,000 monthly transport support for public servants for six months, alongside plans to settle outstanding allowances. However, the Trade Union Congress (TUC) has rejected the temporary relief, proposing a ₦300,000 minimum monthly salary for the lowest-paid federal worker. 2027: NLC urges journalists to push for living wage NLC tackles TUC over opposition to N70,000 transport allowance deal Morning recap: States hold N264bn UBEC funds, FG’s N465bn transport plan, other top stories The disagreement has renewed conversations about workers’ purchasing power, rising living costs and the government’s handling of previous wage agreements.
